## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A binary bounding volume hierarchy over 3D primitives: the standard
// ray-tracing and broad-phase accelerator. Node 0 is the root;
// PrimitiveIndices is the leaf-order permutation of the caller's primitives.
// Instances come from BuildBvh (spatial-structures.library.plato) or from a
// host that emits the same encoding.
type Bvh3D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex3D, IRaycast3D
{
    Nodes: Array<BvhNode3D>;
    PrimitiveIndices: Array<ItemIndex>;
}

//==
// ## Region trees (quadtree, octree)

// One node of a quadtree. FirstChild is the node index of the first of four
// consecutive children (ordered -X-Y, +X-Y, -X+Y, +X+Y), or -1 for a leaf.
// Items is a half-open range into the owning tree's ItemIndices.
type QuadtreeNode
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
    FirstChild: SpatialNodeIndex;
    Items: IntegerInterval;
}

// A quadtree (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadtree) over a square 2D region.
// Node 0 is the root and covers Bounds; each level splits its square into four
// equal quadrants, to at most MaxDepth levels below the root. No builder yet:
// instances come from a host, until BuildOctree
// (spatial-structures.library.plato) gains a 2D twin.
type Quadtree2D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex2D
{
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
    Nodes: Array<QuadtreeNode>;
    ItemIndices: Array<ItemIndex>;
    MaxDepth: Integer;
}

// One node of an octree. FirstChild is the node index of the first of eight
// consecutive children (ordered by octant: X varies fastest, then Y, then
// Z), or -1 for a leaf. Items is a half-open range into ItemIndices.
type OctreeNode
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
    FirstChild: SpatialNodeIndex;
    Items: IntegerInterval;
}

// An octree (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Octree) over a cubic 3D region.
// Node 0 is the root and covers Bounds; each level splits its cube into eight
// equal octants, to at most MaxDepth levels below the root. Instances come
// from BuildOctree (spatial-structures.library.plato) or from a host that
// emits the same encoding.
type Octree3D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex3D
{
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
    Nodes: Array<OctreeNode>;
    ItemIndices: Array<ItemIndex>;
    MaxDepth: Integer;
}

// An octree whose node bounds are enlarged by the factor Looseness (1 means
// exact; 2 is common), letting each item live wholly inside one node:
// cheap incremental updates for moving objects. Instances come from
// BuildLooseOctree (spatial-structures.library.plato) or from a host.
type LooseOctree3D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex3D
{
    Octree: Octree3D;
    Looseness: Number;
}
```
